item.title: Governing Emerging Ocean Technologies for Climate Action: Marine Policy and International Regulation in the Age of AI and Spatial Computing
item.content:encoded:
This special issue examines the governance frameworks and international regulatory approaches necessary to manage emerging ocean technologies in the context of climate action. It addresses how artificial intelligence and spatial computing applications can be effectively regulated within marine policy to support sustainable ocean management and climate mitigation goals.

item.title: Ownership and Access in Fisheries Production, Processing and Trade
item.content:encoded:
This special issue explores questions of ownership structures and access rights across the fisheries value chain, from production through processing to trade. The focus encompasses how different ownership models and access arrangements shape fisheries systems and outcomes.

item.title: Transdisciplinary Actions on the Impacts of Climate Change on Coastal Society
item.content:encoded:
This special issue in Marine Policy focuses on transdisciplinary approaches to understanding and addressing the impacts of climate change on coastal societies. The call invites research that bridges multiple disciplines to examine how climate change affects coastal communities and what integrated solutions can be developed to support adaptation and resilience in these vulnerable regions.
